english.title: Person in control / manager of vehicle fail to prevent smoking in that vehicle when child present - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in control or concerned in the management of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[that]_
(B)_[a part of which, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF VEHICLE..),]_

was enclosed and in which more than one person was present, one of whom was a person under the age of 18, failed to cause a person smoking in

(C)_[the]_
(D)_[that part of the]_

vehicle to stop smoking
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(1A) of the Smoke-free (Exemptions and Vehicles) Regulations 2007 and section 8(1), (4) and (7) of the Health Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person in control / concerned in the management of smoke-free vehicle
fail to prevent smoking

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 8(5) of the Act provides defences to the offence.
(ii) If it is the person in control or concerned in the management of the vehicle who is smoking, they would be liable for prosecution for this offence as well as 'Smoking in a vehicle in which a child was present' (see CJS code HA06014 - PNLD document H12359), and may receive a fixed penalty fine for each offence
(iii) If the offence is committed in Wales see H12372 (CJS code HA06015)
